title: Retained-bind deferral does not say why the bind failed: show the Engram refusal code or "transport/unknown" in the preview and host log
outcome: Retained-bind deferral does not say why the bind failed: show the Engram refusal code or "transport/unknown" in the preview and host log
acceptance: When a turn-start Engram bind is deferred to the retained-bind retry, the session preview and a host log line name the failure class: the Engram refusal code when Engram answered with a typed refusal, or transport/unknown when no typed answer arrived. Each later retry attempt that fails records its own class.

A test drives a typed Engram bind refusal and a transport failure into the deferral path and asserts the preview and log name each class; the existing deferral, retry schedule and eligibility behaviour are unchanged.
